assumptions: The phrase "4 times more" is ambiguous between four times as many and four times in addition to Neil's amount; F3-v1 has no ambiguity-preserving predicate.
The dollar-denominated table values under the "(in millions)" header are represented in million_usd without conversion.

f3_program: collection("cookout.kids", "kid", "cookout", source("some kids at a cookout"))
fraction_of(at("cookout.kids.count", "2005"), at("cookout.kids.count", "2004"), 1, 2, source("In 2005, half the number of kids came to the cookout as compared to 2004"))
fraction_of(at("cookout.kids.count", "2006"), at("cookout.kids.count", "2005"), 2, 3, source("In 2006, 2/3 as many kids came to the cookout as in 2005"))
observe(at("cookout.kids.count", "2006"), 20, "count", source("there were 20 kids at the cookout in 2006"))

assumptions: The dollar-denominated table values are represented in million_usd because the source states that the carrying amounts are in millions.

f3_program: fraction_of("jean.stuffies.kept.count", at("jean.stuffies.count", "initial"), 1, 3, source("She keeps 1/3 of them"))
remove("give_away_rest", "jean", at("jean.stuffies.count", "current"), "jean.stuffies.given_away.count", source("gives away the rest"))
sum_relation(at("jean.stuffies.count", "initial"), "jean.stuffies.kept.count", event_field("give_away_rest", "quantity"), source("She keeps 1/3 of them and then gives away the rest"))

transfer("give_to_janet", "jean", at("jean.stuffies.given_away.count", "current"), at("janet.stuffies.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("give_away_rest", "quantity"), 1, 4), source("She gives 1/4 of what she gave away to her sister Janet"))
assumptions: The second giveaway statement allocates one quarter of the already characterized giveaway amount to Janet, rather than withdrawing that amount again from Jean's retained stock.
